draft.text: From Token to Fleet is a technical guide that explains how large language model systems transition from processing a single token to coordinating a distributed fleet of GPUs. It examines the architecture decisions, resource management challenges, and performance trade‑offs that arise at each stage of scaling. Engineers who design or operate large‑scale LLM systems can use it as a reference for practical implementation.
